title: Aged murine bone marrow myeloid and mesenchymal cells develop unique senescence phenotypes
why_chosen: Theme 1+3+7 hit: paired CyTOF in same mouse shows MSC p16 +170% vs myeloid; LysM-Cre × p16-LOX-ATTAC clearance fails to rescue bone (myeloid repopulates fast, no BCL2 surge, no YAP/TAZ loss, no cGAS/STING). Directly questions D+Q substrate identity in BM.

title: Senolytic Treatment With Dasatinib and Quercetin Reshapes Influenza-Specific CD8 T Cell Responses During Infection in Aged, Vaccinated Mice
why_chosen: Theme 1+7: same D+Q dose (5/50 mg/kg) as user; aged C57BL/6; primary efficacy missed but CD8 immunodominance NP→PA reorganized. Cross-system anchor for v11 narrative D+Q = immunomodulation > senolysis (Discussion §3.7 with Doolittle 2026).

title: Deciphering the evolving niche interactome of human hematopoietic stem cells from ontogeny to aging
why_chosen: Theme 4+5+2 hit: 11 public scRNA-seq integrated (86 samples, 26 cell types, ~576k cells) across AGM/FL/FBM/YBM/OBM. CellChat shows biphasic aging dynamics (FBM>YBM dip, OBM rebound) driven by plasma/T-NK/MSC as new senders. WNT10A/WNT5B and GZMA-PARD3 OBM-specific; CXCL12-CXCR4 MSC->HSPC up YBM->OBM. NicheNet ranks SPP1 (MSC), MMP9 + FCAR (mono/mac+gran) as top ligands driving HSPC JUN/JUND/FOS/VEGFA/TGFB1. Directly mappable onto Giwon's v11: MSC #1 reversal rank can be reframed as SPP1-mediated AP-1 cooling.

title: Reversing lysosomal dysfunction restores youthful state in aged hematopoietic stem cells
why_chosen: Theme 1+2+7 hit: Mount Sinai Ghaffari lab. v-ATPase inhibitor ex vivo treatment of aged LT-HSCs restores lysosomal pH, reduces cytosolic mtDNA leak, calms cGAS-STING, dampens interferon program, and rescues in vivo repopulation capacity >8-fold in competitive BMT. Provides the cell-autonomous COUNTERPART to our G11BM paper's niche-routed D+Q rejuvenation — citable as complementary mechanism in Discussion §3.10. The cGAS-STING/mtDNA chain also anchors our HSPC interferon signature reinterpretation (Stage 39).

title: Distinct senotypes in p16- and p21-positive cells across human and mouse aging tissues
why_chosen: Theme 1+3+7 hit: scRNA-seq meta-analysis across 6 aging tissues (4 mouse + 2 human). p16+ and p21+ cells are largely non-overlapping independent populations (<5% co-expression) — each a distinct senotype with unique cell-type tropism and SASP. Bone: p16+=osteocytes (bone loss), p21+=osteochondroprogenitors+neutrophils (fracture healing delay). RNA velocity + Monocle3 confirm no conversion trajectories between senotypes. SASP: bone p16+ Il6/Cxcl12/Mmp13 vs p21+ Tgfb1/Cxcl10/Ccl2. Direct v11 link: D+Q SASP components can be re-attributed to p16+ vs p21+ senotype source; Doolittle (JCI 2026 co-author) is co-author here — narrative bridge natural. OA confirmed PMC12669595.
